title: DNS sign-in and QQ notifications
keyNeeded: An administrator must configure a 32-byte CERTIMATE_DNS_TOTP_KEY or PocketBase encryption key.
authenticatorHelp: Changing the authenticator signs out all sessions. Use the next code when signing in again.
secretHelp: Leave blank to keep the current secret for the same client and endpoints.
redirect: Register this redirect URI with the identity provider.
qqSecret: Set CERTIMATE_DNS_QQBOT_SECRET in the service environment.
pairHelp: Send this code in a private message to the bot within five minutes.
adminCaptchaOn: Image verification is enabled for administrator sign-in.
adminCaptchaOff: Image verification is disabled for administrator sign-in.
adminScan: Scan this QR code in your authenticator app and enter the code it generates.
adminRecovery: Lost access to your authenticator? A server operator can reset it with the dns-admin-reset command.
